lines.text: On Pentecost, they were all together in one place when a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven.
Fiery tongues rested on each of them, and they were filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke in other tongues.
Jews from every nation lived in Jerusalem, and a crowd, each hearing his own prayer, asked if they were Galileans.
The crowd, including visitors from Rome, Cretans and Arabs, heard them in their own languages declaring the wonders of David.
Astounded and perplexed, they asked what it meant, but others mocked them, saying they were drunk on new wine.
